lead_story: The July CPI inflation report is expected to be a big deal for the Fed, with Fed Governor Cook saying she's prepared to act on a rate hike to address inflation. The Fed's decision will have a significant impact on the US economy and financial markets. The inflation report will be released on Wednesday and is expected to guide the Fed's next move on interest rates.
